Formidine Rift

3307-04-02 → 3307-07-29 · 6 articles
Significance medium
Summary
The search for the truth behind the Dynasty Project, a covert mission to install beacons in remote galactic regions whose ships never returned.
Overview
The discovery of the Dynasty Project—a covert mission in the 3270s to install beacons in the Formidine Rift, Conflux, and Hawkin's Gap—and the subsequent search for what happened to the fleet.
Status
Resolved
Outcome
The Dynasty Project was confirmed. Shipwrecks, beacons, and abandoned settlements from the 3270s were discovered. The Zurara megaship was found with its crew dead.

Chronology (6 articles)
3307-07-29
Far God Megaship Initiative Concludes
The Pleiades Concordat's initiative concludes successfully. The Testament will serve as a missionary vessel while the Perdition and Sacrosanct embark on a pilgrimage into deep space. New convert Leonard Yates (Eighty-Ninth Adherent of the Sixtieth Chapter) expresses gratitude for galactic community support.
3307-07-22
Initiative to Outfit Far God Megaships
The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space. Bounties are offered to protect deliveries from anti-xeno extremists.
3307-07-19
Galactic Mysteries: The Far God Cult
Erik Gunnarson examines the Far God cult, a Thargoid-worshipping religious order that has grown from a fringe sect to a widespread religion. Followers believe the Thargoids are heralds of an apocalyptic entity called the Far God. The cult is pacifistic and has recently begun migrating to the Panjabell system.
3307-07-09
Scriveners Clan Abandons the Hesperus
The Scriveners Clan dredger leaves the Perseus Dark Region KC-V c2-2 system after stripping the Hesperus's innards. Erik Gunnarson speculates they abandoned the salvage due to unwanted attention from thousands of curious travellers, or because they detected richer resources elsewhere.
3307-04-12
Galactic Mysteries: Dredger Clans
Erik Gunnarson of Wallglass Investigations discusses the nomadic Dredger Clans — tribes living in converted bulk cruisers that roam deep space, scavenging and occasionally raiding. He mentions the Phagos clan's terrifying reputation and rumours of a rarely seen clan resurfacing.
3307-04-02
Galactic Mysteries: Generation Ships
Investigators Erik Gunnarson and Francesca Wolfe explore the mysteries of abandoned generation ships, recounting chilling tales of the Thetis, Lazarus, Pleione, Artemis, Demeter, and the Golconda — relics of pre-hyperdrive colonisation efforts.
